name: mf-settings
description: Hybrid Settings micro frontend — the SECOND hybrid micro frontend in this architecture. It has the same DUAL NATURE as mf-home: simultaneously a Module Federation remote (exposes modules via ModuleFederationPlugin) AND a single-spa application (exports bootstrap/mount/unmount lifecycle hooks). This second MF demonstrates that the Hybrid pattern SCALES — adding a new micro frontend is just repeating the same pattern with a different name, port, and component. The shell loads this app's code via Module Federation and manages its lifecycle via single-spa.
